title: THE SPIRIT OF GOD IN HIM

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "The plan seemed good to Pharaoh and to all his officials. So Pharaoh asked them, 'Can we find anyone like this man, one in whom is the spirit of God?' Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, 'Since God has made all this known to you, there is no one so discerning and wise as you. You shall be in charge of my palace, and all my people are to submit to your orders. Only with respect to the throne will I be greater than you.'" - Gen 41:37-40 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Pharaoh is deeply impressed — not merely with Joseph's plan, but with something deeper he senses in the man. "Can we find anyone like this," he asks, "one in whom is the spirit of God?" Even a pagan king could see that Joseph was different, that God's presence rested upon him. And so Pharaoh puts him in charge of all Egypt, second only to the throne.

What a testimony. Joseph's God-given wisdom and character were so evident that an unbeliever recognized the hand of God on his life. Joseph did not announce, "I have God's Spirit"; his life simply showed it. His discernment, his humility, his integrity all pointed to a source beyond himself.

This is a challenge and an encouragement for us. Do the people around us — including those who do not share our faith — sense something of God in our lives? Not because we boast about it, but because our wisdom, character, and peace quietly reveal His presence. Jesus said, "let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven" (Matt 5:16).

We cannot manufacture this; it comes from walking closely with God over time, through both prison and palace. As we abide in Him, His Spirit shapes us, and others begin to notice. May our lives, like Joseph's, cause even outsiders to sense that God is with us.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do others sense something of God in my life?
2. Is my witness more about my words or my character?
3. How can I walk closely enough with God that His Spirit shows?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, may Your presence in my life be evident to those around me, even to those who do not yet know You. Shape me by Your Spirit, so that my life quietly points others to You. Amen.
